title: Harold Malmgren's deathbed account of Naval Intelligence

tellings.quote: naval intelligence are going to be around asking you questions about your study. They really get curious and if they talk to you for any length of time, they'll say, "Holy you really know a lot." They're going to offer you special access.

plain: A man named Harold Malmgren said near the end of his life that he was warned Naval Intelligence, the US Navy's spy service, would come asking about his study, would be impressed by how much he knew, and would "offer you special access" into secret work. Michels relays this as Malmgren's deathbed account, as a picture of how outsiders get pulled into hidden programs.
